falsification_conditions.condition: SPY closes above 470 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The March 2024 ETF pattern featured breakdown continuation, not V-recovery; a close above 470 would break the pattern's lower-high structure and invalidate the bearish continuation thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 60 implies elevated volatility/uncertainty; sustained VIX compression below 14 would signal complacency inconsistent with the pattern's volatility regime and negate the stress-signal validity

falsification_conditions.condition: Aggregate ETF inflows exceed $15 billion in any single week (per Bloomberg ETF flows)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The top_2024_mar_etf pattern was characterized by accelerating outflows; a single week of +$15B inflows would demonstrate demand absorption incompatible with the distribution phase the pattern requires

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
